title: Actionist semantic token contract
description: The host-owned semantic vocabulary that any surface -- owned, extracted, bridged or framed -- may reference. Deliberately narrower than the 75-requirement authored pack: a pack is what Actionist authors, this contract is what a binding may reference. Keeping the referencing surface narrow is what makes donor binding tractable.
boundaries: research-only; no implementation, execution or admission authorized

derives_from.pack_schema: research/token-pack-science-2026-08-27.md section 4 (75 numbered requirements across 10 groups)
derives_from.built_precedent: SISOCRM THEMING-CONTRACT.md (scoped bridge, HSL/RGB conversion trap, dark mirror, identical-first)

namespace.rule: Donor variable names never enter the host namespace, and host role names never enter a donor scope. A binding translates between them at a declared scope selector; it does not merge them.
namespace.root_policy: Host semantic roles are declared at :root. Donor bindings are NEVER declared at :root -- see donor-token-binding.schema.json scope_selector.
namespace.collision_rule: Two distinct token systems sharing a scope is a defect regardless of whether it renders.

encodings.conversion_rule: When a donor's encoding differs from the host's, the binding MUST declare a conversion. Aliasing across differing encodings is schema-invalid, parses successfully, renders, and is wrong.
encodings.evidence: SISOCRM THEMING-CONTRACT.md: Teable consumes hsl(var(--background)) from HSL triplets; host consumes rgb(var(--crm-brand-rgb) / <alpha>) from RGB triplets. '--background: var(--crm-canvas-rgb) is silently wrong -- 13 14 13 read as HSL is not the dark grey it is as RGB.'
encodings.gate: Gate L (encoding-correctness probe) is the only gate that catches an aliased mismatch.
encodings.alpha_rule: Donor values may carry alpha (observed: '--border: 0 0% 0% / 0.08'). A binding must preserve alpha explicitly; dropping it is a silent visual change.

mode_policy.pairing_rule: Every role resolves in every supported mode. A role present in light but absent in dark fails gate B unless modeBehavior:invariant is explicit and validated.
mode_policy.inversion_rule: dark = invert(light) is FORBIDDEN by default (gate F). A pack may opt in explicitly only if all other gates pass.
mode_policy.donor_rule: A bound donor surface requires a dark mirror of its binding. Mode switching breaks at donor boundaries first (gate N).

forbidden: primitive referencing semantic or component (pack requirement 73)
semantic referencing a donor token (inverts ownership; donor upgrade would restyle the host)
one donor's tokens referencing another donor's tokens
component referencing another component's private token unless explicitly allowed (pack requirement 37)

surface.ordering_rule: canvas < surface < raised < overlay in the pack's declared lightness/elevation policy; numeric lightness ordering is NOT assumed identical in light and dark (gate F).

action.precedence_rule: disabled overrides hover; focus-visible does not disappear under selected; invalid overrides valid (pack requirement 36).

status.gate: Gate I -- hue may never be the only cue.

nav.donor_bindable_reason: Navigation is host-owned without exception. The built estate's rail is 100% host-authored and no donor nav was ever adopted. Handing nav roles to a donor invites a second navigation silo.

shape.note: Radius is explicitly in scope for donor binding -- the built precedent includes --radius in its bridge and names density/radius tokenisation as an open item.

elevation.note: Shadow colour and opacity differ by mode; a single elevation value across modes is a defect.

space.relational_rule: Spacing inside a group is tighter than spacing between groups. Equal gaps everywhere destroys hierarchy.
space.note: Donor spacing binding is frequently NOT reachable -- most donors do not publish spacing as tokens. Expect declared unstylable entries here.

type.note: Font family is often the single highest-leverage donor binding: one variable changes the perceived identity of an entire donor surface.

motion.donor_bindable_reason: Donor motion is almost never token-exposed and is rarely worth the coupling. Reduced-motion alternatives remain mandatory for owned surfaces.

shell.donor_bindable_reason: Host composition geometry. Exists only in the Actionist shell; no donor should ever receive these. Coordinated with S2-L3.
shell.precedent: The built estate enforces exactly this class of rail-geometry tokens as required consumption in its design-token check.

closed_world.rule: Unknown role names and raw style literals are build errors, not fallbacks (pack requirement 10).
closed_world.generator_vocabulary: The model selects role names, never values: 'action-primary', never '#3b82f6'; 'space-3', never '12px' (pack requirement 75).
closed_world.scope_qualification: Closed-world literal scanning applies to B1 (owned) and B2 (extracted) surfaces. B3/B4/B5 donor surfaces are excluded from source-literal scanning and are instead subject to gates K-N, because a compiled donor bundle is entirely literals from the host's perspective and a cross-origin donor is unreachable by any scan.

inherited.B: completeness / closed world -- AMENDED: source-literal clause applies to B1/B2 only
inherited.C: WCAG 2.2 contrast (4.5 normal, 3.0 large, 3.0 non-text; no rounding up)
inherited.D: APCA quality gate (pinned implementation; no WCAG 3 conformance claim)
inherited.E: ramp monotonicity and uniformity (thresholds proposed, require calibration)
inherited.H: spacing/geometry scale membership and hit targets
inherited.J: runtime literal audit -- AMENDED: source-side only; cannot see compiled donor output, inline styles or cross-origin surfaces

added_by_p07.K: resolved-property audit -- computed styles resolve in every mode; no namespace leakage in either direction
added_by_p07.L: encoding-correctness probe -- rendered colour equals converted expected colour; the only gate catching an aliased encoding mismatch
added_by_p07.M: visual-diff coherence -- M1 identical-first (pixel, tolerance ~0) and M2 cross-surface property agreement (threshold proposed, requires calibration)
added_by_p07.N: mode-transition integrity -- re-run K, L, M1 after mode switch on every bound surface
